name: How much does cabinet removal usually cost, and is it worth it?

mainEntity.name: How much does cabinet removal usually cost, and is it worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the number of cabinets, whether countertops and appliances are included, and whether the crew is hauling debris away. A salvage-friendly removal can sometimes reduce overall cost if the cabinets have resale or repurposing value, while damaged or glued-in cabinets may cost more to remove.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price depends on kitchen size, cabinet condition, and whether countertops, appliances, and haul-away are included. If the cabinets can be reused or repurposed, that may lower the total cost.
